recommendation: Keep the audit as-is and do not add waiting to Encounter.status for FHIR-13702. If PA wants a standardized waiting subjectStatus code or deeper ED workflow guidance, that should be a new work-group decision because current source matches the published modified resolution and later Encounter refinements.
issue_request: FHIR-13702 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to add a waiting code to Encounter.status to track waiting time during outpatient and similar encounters; the accepted resolution instead added Encounter.subjectStatus, reorganized Encounter.status/subjectStatus values, updated status-management guidance, and deferred statusHistory changes to FHIR-14157.
initial_application: The Jira comment records partial application via GF#13072. Git history shows b8e66a8579ca2e5e44a6fbd18ba4362b631a38f8 added Encounter.subjectStatus, reorganized statuses and examples, and created subject-status terminology; FHIR-13702 follow-up commits 84c280b9715941ba29c953bf6c3cd14779d381ce and dc223befbe35bc659d657b3124bc6a70d697583d completed Status Management and QA wording around waiting-like subjectStatus use.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, making the Encounter structure, status terminology, subject-status value set, and Encounter narrative build-scope source. Later FHIR-32343 intentionally relaxed Encounter.subjectStatus from extensible to example and added subject-status definitions/receiving-care semantics, so the current binding strength supersedes the original FHIR-13702 resolution text. FHIR-14157 separately handled the deferred statusHistory/classHistory redesign through EncounterHistory. Searches found no direct FHIR-13702 community decision that conflicts with the Jira/source/git trail.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already has Encounter.status as a required overall encounter state with no waiting code, Encounter.subjectStatus as the patient-specific status, and narrative guidance that local workflows may represent a waiting status using the example subjectStatus binding.

evidence_items.learned: This establishes the target behavior: keep Encounter.status focused on overall encounter state and use subjectStatus/local workflow codes for waiting-like patient states.

evidence_items.summary: Encounter is an active build resource; Encounter.status is required and bound to encounter-status, while Encounter.subjectStatus is a CodeableConcept with an example binding to encounter-subject-status.
evidence_items.learned: The active source already implements the intended status/subjectStatus split.

evidence_items.learned: Current source matches the modified resolution by not adding waiting to the required Encounter.status value set.
